source: Fictional chamber choir board meeting (Swedish with an English-speaking conductor, heavy code-switching) written for Task Q (scripts/notes-eval.ts). Fictional choir and people; no real meeting.
traps: Ticket price proposed as 150 kr, changed to 120 kr (60 kr students) before it is decided.
Felix offers to make the posters, Maja takes them over mid-sentence in English; Felix does the Facebook event instead.
Oliver 'could maybe ask' about borrowing risers, 'men jag lovar ingenting' (not an action).
The spring tour is explicitly NOT decided; to the next meeting (allowed only as a deferral). Oliver's proposal IS an action.
Ingrid typed the concert date decision into the notes tab before the meeting; it must not be duplicated.
Code-switching sv/en within sentences; notes stay in Swedish.
Numbers and dates in words (hundratjugo, sjätte december / the sixth of December).
